proves: notice and control dictionaries are closed
alerts, runbooks and kill switches are linked
draft artifacts contain no recognized provider credential shape
doesNotProve: legal, privacy, license, customer-copy or on-call approval

dependencies: isolated deploy identity and schema/config snapshot
customer notice approval bound to exact hashes

serviceLevelTargets.target: 30d >= 99.9%; expected 4xx excluded; 5xx and timeout are failures
>= 99.9%; server p95 <= 1s; album does not require panorama
named 4G/25Mbps profile p75 <= 3s; Scene lazy load measured separately
>= 99.0%; no duplicate photo or receipt; partial count is exact
p95 <= 30s; abstain is not a system failure

alerts.condition: authorized API or Viewer burn rate exceeds the approved multi-window policy
alerts.recovery: stabilize the affected read or write path and roll back only to a CAS-safe release
alerts.reconciliation: compare request outcomes, mutation receipts and aggregate versions for the alert window
alerts.escalation: page service owner and release controller

alerts.condition: 5xx or timeout rate exceeds the approved route-class threshold
alerts.recovery: remove the failing deploy or dependency path without reviving obsolete writers
alerts.reconciliation: replay idempotent jobs and reconcile receipts against committed rows
alerts.escalation: page API owner and release controller

alerts.condition: observed object bytes, checksum, MIME, decoder result or committed item count diverges
readOnlyDiagnosis: inspect decoder build and upload receipt
identify affected batches without opening media
alerts.recovery: quarantine affected objects and retry only from verified source bytes
alerts.reconciliation: prove no visible Photo references mismatched bytes
alerts.escalation: page media, API and security owners

alerts.condition: viewer projection succeeds without the current canonical authorization predicate
readOnlyDiagnosis: inspect cache and signed-object lookup order
alerts.recovery: revoke affected reads before cache or artifact cleanup
alerts.reconciliation: scan request and object access records for the affected predicate version
alerts.escalation: page security, API, Viewer and release controller

alerts.condition: a cross-Space sentinel read or mutation is not denied before object disclosure or state change
readOnlyDiagnosis: inspect object-read count and database diff
alerts.recovery: revoke the affected authority family and deploy a fail-closed relation check
alerts.reconciliation: enumerate affected request IDs and prove zero unauthorized object or row access
alerts.escalation: page security and release controller immediately

alerts.condition: queue age, retry count or dead-letter rate exceeds the approved per-job policy
readOnlyDiagnosis: split by job kind and build
compare dependency health and idempotency keys
alerts.recovery: stop only new affected jobs, drain bounded retries and resume from current row versions
alerts.reconciliation: verify no duplicate placement, question, preview or artifact side effect
alerts.escalation: page affected worker owner and release controller

alerts.condition: active panorama, revision, asset or switch transaction violates the frozen invariant
readOnlyDiagnosis: compare active panorama and revision rows
inspect switch transaction and audit event
alerts.recovery: stop panorama switching and restore the last verified current revision without old writers
alerts.reconciliation: prove one current panorama projection and matching asset provenance per affected Space
alerts.escalation: page panorama, API and release owners

alerts.condition: item lock, aggregate version or immutable event does not describe the same committed mutation
alerts.recovery: stop affected writes and reconcile from immutable receipts and events
alerts.reconciliation: prove each committed side effect has one matching event and no stale writer won

alerts.condition: metadata backup age exceeds the approved RPO target or backup verification fails
readOnlyDiagnosis: compare database and object snapshot clocks
alerts.recovery: restore backup production and verify a fresh manifest before resuming new writes
alerts.reconciliation: compare latest recoverable point with deletion and revocation ledger heads
alerts.escalation: page data operations and release controller

alerts.condition: isolated restore differs from the expected metadata, object sample, authorization or deletion ledger projection
readOnlyDiagnosis: replay revocation and deletion ledgers before reads
alerts.recovery: keep restored traffic closed, correct the restore procedure and repeat in isolation
alerts.reconciliation: prove deleted, revoked, hidden and rejected content did not revive
alerts.escalation: page data operations, security and release controller

alerts.condition: revoked or deleted media remains readable after the approved revoke interval
readOnlyDiagnosis: inspect CDN and object cache keys
compare purge and deletion ledger events
alerts.recovery: block reads at authorization and origin before retrying bounded purge
alerts.reconciliation: verify all affected URLs, objects and artifacts are denied without reviving unrelated content
alerts.escalation: page media, security and data operations owners

alerts.condition: isolated decoder crashes, times out or exceeds its CPU, memory, wall-time or frame limit
readOnlyDiagnosis: identify decoder build and fixture hash
alerts.recovery: quarantine the source and remove the affected decoder build from service
alerts.reconciliation: prove no derived or visible Photo was created from the failed decode

alerts.condition: a runtime-generated marker appears in any application, edge, analytics, trace, crash, metric or browser sink
readOnlyDiagnosis: do not reproduce with a real credential
alerts.recovery: stop affected paths, revoke exposed authority when applicable and remove leaked material from every sink
alerts.reconciliation: repeat with a fresh runtime marker and record only one-way result identifiers
alerts.escalation: page security and release controller immediately

requiredRestoreScope: all metadata in an isolated environment
deletion and revocation ledgers before traffic

legacyRules: never guess missing owner review or placement
changeDelivery.rollbackRule: never return to a writer without batch, item, receipt CAS and revision checks
